title: The Best and the Rest: Revisiting the Norm of Normality of Individual Performance
read_scope: Author-hosted PDF abstract, performance operationalization and implications passages.
supports: Descriptive performance distributions for the studied occupations and measures.
does_not_establish: Innate ability or need distributions; the counterfactual distribution under equal resources; a causal decomposition of all skewness.

title: The Technology of Skill Formation
read_scope: Published author-hosted AER PDF, opening and skill-formation discussion, especially printed pages 31 and 35–36.
supports: A multistage skill-formation model with environmental investments, self-productivity and dynamic complementarity, organized around developmental evidence.
does_not_establish: Universal normality or a universal exponential law for ability; all resource differences are financial capital.

title: The Matthew effect in science funding
authors: Thijs Bol; Mathijs de Vaan; Arnout van de Rijt
read_scope: Full primary article text returned by PNAS search plus PMC abstract, regression-discontinuity identification and main results.
supports: Local comparison near a Dutch early-career grant threshold: later funding divergence and participation/status mechanisms; original grant excluded from the later-funding comparison.
does_not_establish: A twofold ability difference, all sources of inequality, or normality after resources are equalized.

title: Organized Sports Participation Among Children Aged 6–17 Years: United States, 2020
read_scope: Primary survey brief, income gradient, figure 3 notes and source description.
supports: An association between household income and participation in organized sports.
does_not_establish: An experimental causal effect; running/golf/skydiving ability distributions or a ranking of their distance from normality.
